bio: Frensham Pond Hotel and Spa is nestled in the beautiful countryside of Churt. Experience an alfresco Afternoon Tea overlooking the Great Frensham Pond, that is unique to this hotel.  With a spectacular view of the Great Frensham Pond, The Watermark Restaurant brings a relaxed, yet sophisticated Afternoon Tea to the heart of Churt. Afternoon Tea can also be served on the alfresco terrace.  Every day, freshly baked cakes and scones, and elegant finger sandwiches are made, all served with tea and coffee. Guests can also choose to include a glass of prosecco for a luxury Afternoon Tea experience.  Frensham Pond Hotel is not far from Farnham Station. Afternoon Tea is served daily from 12pm - 5:30pm.
